name: diameter_eccentricity
author: ab9fb3a3
description: Computes eccentricity (largest shortest-path distance from a node), diameter, radius, centre and periphery. Use for the most distant nodes or the network centre. Requires a nonempty connected undirected graph or strongly connected directed graph. Defaults to hop distances using BFS; use_weights=true uses Dijkstra with finite non-negative weights. Returns exact full-graph metrics plus up to top_k labelled nodes per list; eccentricities rank descending with node-ID ties. No subgraph is produced.

graph_id.description: ID of a graph registered in the provided store.

top_k.description: Maximum entries in each returned node list; calculations still use the full graph.

use_weights.description: Use non-negative edge weights as distances; false counts hops, even on weighted graphs.
